code:
TDE:              disk (encrypted) -> memory (PLAINTEXT) -> client
Always Encrypted: disk (encrypted) -> memory (STILL ENCRYPTED) -> client decrypts locally

SQL Server itself never has the key for an Always Encrypted column.
caption: Closes the exact gap TDE leaves open: memory and in-use data.

code:
SSN CHAR(11)
  ENCRYPTED WITH (
    COLUMN_ENCRYPTION_KEY = CEK_SSN,
    ENCRYPTION_TYPE = DETERMINISTIC,
    ALGORITHM = 'AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_256'
  ) NOT NULL
caption: The Column Master Key protecting this lives outside SQL Server entirely.
